newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns says expanding research areas.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns says expanding research areas.

text.p: Bear Stearns Cos Inc has been expanding its equity and fixed income research areas and the expansion will continue through 1997, a company spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman did not say how many people the company was adding. Earlier today, in a released statement that accompanied the company's earnings, Bear Stearns chief executive James Cayne said the company has been "expanding all research areas of the firm."
